## Work rights after you graduate

Post-graduation work authorization in the United States is structured under **Optional Practical Training (OPT)**, administered by US Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS).

For Indian STEM graduates (Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, MIS), OPT is the primary mechanism to gain full-time employment at top US technology firms and pay off education loans ([US Education Loans Guide](/study-abroad/study-in/usa/usa-us-education-loans-guide)).

Here is what Indian families need to know upfront:

1. **12 Months Initial OPT + 24 Months STEM Extension**: All international graduates receive **12 months of initial OPT**. STEM-certified degree graduates ([STEM OPT Designated MS Cs](/study-abroad/study-in/usa/usa-stem-opt-designated-ms-cs)) receive an additional 24-month extension, providing **36 months (3 full years)** of total US work authorization.
2. **Unemployment Allowance Limits**: F-1 students on initial 12-month OPT are allowed a maximum cumulative limit of **90 days of unemployment**. Securing a STEM extension grants an **additional 60 days of unemployment allowance**, totaling **150 days across the 36-month period**.
3. **E-Verify Employer Requirement for STEM Extension**: While initial OPT allows working for any employer related to your degree field, your employer MUST be enrolled in the federal **E-Verify Program** to qualify for the 24-month STEM extension.

## 36-Month STEM OPT Timeline & Work Rights

> ### 📋 36-MONTH STEM OPT TIMELINE
> * Months 01 – 12: Initial 12-Month OPT Work Authorization (All Grads)
> * • Max 90 Days Unemployment Allowance
> * • Entry 1 in Annual H-1B Visa Lottery
> * Months 13 – 36: 24-Month STEM OPT Extension (DHS STEM CIP Code Grads)
> * • Requires E-Verified Employer & Form I-983 Plan
> * • Additional 60 Days Unemployment Allowance (150 Total)
> * • Entries 2 and 3 in Annual H-1B Visa Lottery

## Initial OPT vs. 24-Month STEM OPT Extension Comparison

| Parameter | Initial 12-Month OPT | 24-Month STEM OPT Extension |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Eligible Degrees** | All US Master's Degrees (STEM & Non-STEM) | DHS-Certified STEM Degrees Only ([STEM OPT Designated MS Cs](/study-abroad/study-in/usa/usa-stem-opt-designated-ms-cs)) |
| **Application Window** | 90 days before graduation to 60 days after | Up to 90 days before initial OPT expires |
| **USCIS Application Fee** | **$520 USD (Paper) / $470 USD (Online)** | **$520 USD (Paper) / $470 USD (Online)** |
| **Where this fee comes from** | [USCIS Form G-1055 fee schedule, edition 10/26/26](https://www.uscis.gov/sites/default/files/document/forms/g-1055.pdf) | Same fee applies to both OPT types |
| **Employer Requirement** | Any employer related to degree field | **Must be E-Verify Enrolled Employer** |
| **Training Plan Required**| No formal training plan required | **Form I-983 Training Plan Required** |
| **Unemployment Limit** | **Maximum 90 Cumulative Days** | **150 Cumulative Days Total (90 + 60)** |

## Form I-983 Training Plan & E-Verify Requirements

To apply for your 24-month STEM OPT extension, you and your employer must complete **Form I-983 (Mentoring and Training Plan for STEM OPT Students)**:

* **What Form I-983 Verifies**: Details your job duties, specific STEM learning objectives, supervisor evaluation timeline, and confirmation that your salary matches US citizen workers in similar roles.
* **E-Verify Number**: Your hiring manager must provide their company's official **7-digit E-Verify Company Identification Number** to include in your USCIS application.

## Next Steps for Students & Parents

1. Review STEM MS CS degree directory: [STEM OPT MS CS Directory Guide](/study-abroad/study-in/usa/usa-stem-opt-designated-ms-cs).
2. Learn how H-1B visa lottery entries work during STEM OPT: [H-1B Visa Lottery Strategy Guide](/study-abroad/study-in/usa/usa-h1b-lottery-cap-exempt).
3. Explore permanent residency pathways: [EB-2 NIW & Green Card Pathways Guide](/study-abroad/study-in/usa/usa-green-card-eb2-niw-pathways).
